title: {p} Tortilla Soup
steps: Soften the {v} with the {spice} in a pot with a little oil.
Add the {sauce} and enough water to cover, then the {p}, and simmer 20 minutes, until any meat is at least 165°F / 74°C inside. Add any shrimp for the last 3 minutes, until pink and opaque.
Cut the {s} into strips and crisp them in a dry pan or a hot oven.
Ladle the soup over the strips and top with avocado, lime or cilantro.
tip: Bake the tortilla strips, load up on veg and keep the cheese and sour cream light.
